hook: Telangana's *₹5 lakh* family life cover finally opens Nov 19
hook_b: Telangana's *₹5 lakh* family life cover finally opens Nov 19
tldr: CM Revanth Reddy opens applications for the Indiramma Family Insurance scheme at a Siddipet meeting on Thursday, Nov 19; it missed its June 2 launch.

beats.what: The Indiramma Kutumba Jeevitha Bima Pathakam gives families a ₹5 lakh life cover; applications open at a public meeting in Siddipet on Nov 19.
beats.why: Officials told the CM existing schemes give up to ₹2 lakh life cover; he asked for all department insurance schemes under one umbrella, with life cover raised to ₹5 lakh.
beats.care: Accident cover of up to ₹10 lakh stays as it is, the CM said; no one now covered by a government scheme is to be left out.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 18): The CMO statement did not say who is eligible, how much premium the state pays or which insurer carries the risk. Not announced yet.

cards.q: ₹5 lakh family life cover: what matters most to you?

qs: Who counts as the head or main earner when a family applies?
How will merged schemes compare with Rythu Bima's ₹5 lakh payout?

facts.t: Existing accident cover of up to *₹10 lakh* stays unchanged, the CM said.
Rythu Bima, launched in *2018*, pays ₹5 lakh to the family of any farmer who dies.
Sircilla weavers were promised *1 crore* Indiramma sarees, also distributed at the Nov 19 event.

viz.verdict: Higher life cover for covered families; eligibility not announced
Launch came about six months after the original date

learn.t: Rythu Bima = 2018 scheme paying ₹5 lakh to a farmer's family on death

watch: Whether the eligibility rules, premium and insurer are announced at the Siddipet launch.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Telangana's delayed Rs 5-lakh family insurance to launch on Nov 19

fact: Telangana's *₹5 lakh* family life insurance opens applications Nov 19, six months late
twist: The target keeps moving: budget said 1.15 crore families, Cabinet 1.5 crore, the CMO now says 1 crore.
